events.luffy-post-timeskip-return: Luffy gets his hat back on Rusukaina and returns to Sabaody with his post-timeskip look.
events.zoro-post-timeskip-return: Zoro arrives in Sabaody after two years with Mihawk, bearing a scar over his left eye.
events.nami-post-timeskip-return: Nami returns from Weatheria with the new Sorcery Clima-Tact.
events.sanji-post-timeskip-return: Sanji escapes the Kamabakka Kingdom and returns with his new look.
events.usopp-post-timeskip-return: Usopp comes back muscular after training on the Boin Archipelago with Heracles.
events.chopper-post-timeskip-return: Chopper reappears after studying medicine in Torino.
events.brook-soul-king-concert: Brook, now the Soul King, gives his farewell concert in Sabaody.
events.robin-post-timeskip-return: Robin arrives in Sabaody after two years with the Revolutionary Army.
events.franky-new-body-bf37: Franky shows off his new cyborg body, BF-37, built with Vegapunk's technology.
events.luffy-conquerors-haki-sabaody: Luffy knocks out dozens of pirates with Conqueror's Haki.
events.luffy-defeats-pacifista: Luffy, Zoro and Sanji destroy a Pacifista in seconds with their new techniques.
events.straw-hats-set-sail-new-world: The nine Straw Hats, reunited, set sail under the sea aboard the coated Sunny.
